title: Attention Transfer Is Not Universally Effective for Vision Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2605.07191v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A recent work shows that Attention Transfer, which transfers only the attention patterns from a pre-trained teacher Vision Transformer (ViT) to a randomly initialized standard student ViT, is sufficient to recover the full benefit of the teacher's pre-trained weights. We revisit this finding on a comprehensive benchmark of 20 teachers from 11 well-known ViT families and reveal that Attention Transfer is not universally effective. While 7 families transfer successfully, 4 consistently fail, falling up to 5.1\% below the from-scratch no-transfer baseline. Further results demonstrate that this failure is family-consistent across model sizes, and persists under extended training durations, different transfer datasets, and out-of-distribution evaluations. translated_title: 注意力迁移对视觉Transformer并非普遍有效
translated_abstract: 最近的一项研究表明，注意力迁移——即仅将预训练教师视觉Transformer（ViT）的注意力模式迁移到随机初始化的标准学生ViT——就足以完全恢复教师预训练权重所带来的收益。我们在一个涵盖来自11个知名ViT家族的20个教师的综合基准上重新审视了这一发现，揭示出注意力迁移并非普遍有效。虽然其中7个家族的迁移能够成功，但另有4个家族持续失败，其性能甚至比从零开始训练（无迁移）的基线低出最多5.1%。进一步的结果表明，这种失败在不同模型规模上具有家族一致性，并且在延长训练时间、更换迁移数据集以及分布外评估的条件下依然存在。随后的对照分析一致地将问题定位到注意力路由通道，表明关键问题并不在于学生能否匹配教师的注意力……
tldr: 本研究通过对来自11个ViT家族的20个教师模型进行系统基准测试，发现注意力迁移并非普遍有效——其中4个ViT家族的注意力迁移持续失败且性能低于从零训练的基线，且该失败在不同模型规模、训练时长、数据集和分布外评估下均保持一致，其根源被定位在注意力路由通道。
en_tdlr: Through a comprehensive benchmark of 20 teachers from 11 ViT families, this study shows that Attention Transfer is not universally effective—4 ViT families consistently fail and underperform the from-scratch baseline, with the failure persisting across model sizes, training durations, datasets, and out-of-distribution evaluations, and the root cause localized to the attention-routing channel.
